title: allow read-only roles to set a shell variable for the worktree path in a compound command

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-145500-0d5c, project ork, item S349:

allow read-only roles to set a shell variable for the worktree path in a compound command

Evidence: a Bash call with W=/path and sed/rg on $W was denied as "A variable in this command can't be checked before it runs"
